notes.subject: teḥri
notes.rationale: נפש d amanay-is iḥerri/tanedmirt/tanedalt, mačči d rrûḥ s yiman-is

notes.subject: צדקה ... מן
notes.rationale: ḥeqq deg wenrar-nni: 'tuḥeqqef ugar' (KJV) neɣ 'tura d tintullin maḍi' (Pesaḥ wuɣur d taẓeḍḍaṭ)

notes.subject: ugar n
notes.rationale: המוותא מן (s taɛbranit נפשה מן) yettwaxdem s wawal n wenrar, ayen ur nelli ara deg uḍris s wudem ilaw

notes.subject: imesluk / ubelial
notes.rationale: משובה = 'tin id-yuɣlen ɣer deffir', בוגדה = 'tan ur nesttek ara / tabeṛṛanit'; iẓuranen-nni ur llin ara s wawal yiwen deg teqbaylit

translation: Yenna Yahwe ɣur-i: Yisrael imesluk yettwuḥeqqef maḍi s teḥri-ines, ugar n Yehuda ubelial.
